metadata.lesson: Same-source six-language preparation can share source analysis and background separation, but any visual repair defect propagates to every language. Source-local classical inpainting produced obvious patches; local LaMa improved text removal but left soft clothing/hair, apple/hand ghosting and source-colour/glyph fragments at transitions. These candidate videos remain revise. Exact native script, actual mixed-audio DTW, independent transcription, decoded glyph boundary measurements and mux timebase correlation are separate evidence. An invalid optional accent was rejected at createTask; singleton JSON review envelopes were recovered locally from saved receipts without another charge. One source and six locales are not six independent source validations.
metadata.evidence_semantics: Embedded historical records are immutable observations. Their old path strings are origin labels, not live dependencies. Use only this manifest's files.
metadata.proof_boundary: Preserved text, feedback and actual observed image/audio evidence. Does not preserve every full-video frame or make unobserved claims pass.
